name: agentx
description: Connect your coding agent to your AgentX node: check agents, read recent chats, schedules and the wiki, and (when you allow it) hand tasks to your agents.

tools.title: Tool set
tools.description: read only looks: agents, health, recent chats, events, schedules and the wiki. full also sends messages, starts tasks, changes schedules and answers approvals.

daemon_url.title: Node address
daemon_url.description: Address of your AgentX node, for example http://node.example.com:18800. Empty uses node.bind from agentx.json in the folder below, else http://localhost:18800.

token.title: Node token
token.description: The node's MESH_TOKEN. Needed only for a node on another machine. Empty falls back to MESH_TOKEN, then the install's .env file, then dashboard.token.

install_dir.title: AgentX folder
install_dir.description: The folder that holds agentx.json, as a full path, for example /home/you/agentx. The default . is the folder Claude Code was started in.
